# Okay

> Okay develops software, AI agents, and business automation, with product discovery, specialist review, deployment, and marketing support.

Official website: https://okai.sa
Primary language: Arabic. English content is also available.

## Start here
- [Arabic overview](https://okai.sa/ar): idea-to-launch journey, agent workflow examples, controls, and working models.
- [English overview](https://okai.sa/en): English version of the same offering.
- [How we work](https://okai.sa/ar/how-it-works): discovery, specialist review, prototype, build, launch, and growth.
- [Agents](https://okai.sa/ar/agents): representative specialized agent workflows.
- [Technology](https://okai.sa/ar/technology): development simulation, integration approaches, and deployment controls.
- [Company](https://okai.sa/ar/company): project delivery, partnership, and our business-incubator vision.
- [Questions](https://okai.sa/ar/resources): answers about scope, integration, and partnership.

## Scope and qualifications
Project delivery follows agreed scope and milestones. Partnership is subject to assessment and an agreement defining contributions, ownership, and returns; it targets lower upfront cost in exchange for shared risk. No success guarantee is offered.

Becoming a business incubator is a vision, not a current certification or accredited status.

All interface demonstrations are representative simulations, not customer case studies. Integration requires reviewing interfaces, permissions, and data. Security controls are design considerations, not claims of certification.

The idea brief tool is a local prototype. It does not contact an AI model, send submissions to a server, or book specialist sessions.
